question: To what kind of person is a teaching said to be given when that person is endowed with all states and has made a firm determination?
premises: A teaching is marked as to be given.
The recipient is endowed with all states.
The recipient is one who has made a firm determination.
inference: Transmission is enjoined to one who is endowed with all states and of resolved determination.
uncertainties: The identity of the teaching to be given is not stated in this verse.
plain_english: It is to be given to one endowed with all states and to one of resolved determination.
